title: Silent Night
lyrics_original: All is calm, all is bright
Round yon virgin, mother and child.
Holy Infant so tender and mild
Son of God, love's pure light
Radiant beams from Thy holy face
With the dawn of redeeming grace
author_english: Franz Xaver Gruber and Joseph Mohr

bible_verses.english: She gave birth to her firstborn son, and she wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
The angel said to them, "Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for entering our noisy, broken world with Your holy calm and radiant light. Quiet my anxious thoughts today so I may behold the beauty of Your salvation and rest in Your heavenly peace. Just as the shepherds marveled at Your birth, fill my heart with awe and gratitude for Your endless love. Guard my mind in Your stillness and teach me to trust in You completely. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In the quiet stillness of Bethlehem, God fulfilled His ancient promise through the birth of a humble Child. 'Silent Night' gently invites us to step away from the world's busyness and behold the wondrous peace of Christ's arrival. As heaven's glory broke through the dark sky to comfort fearful shepherds, Jesus comes to quiet our restless hearts today. May His holy presence draw you into deep gratitude and still your soul in His perfect love.
